mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications ( notification_id, recipient_user_id, type, title, body, read, read_at, actor_user_id, target_type, target_id, target_url, image_url, metadata_json, created_at ) VALUES ( #{notificationId}, #{recipientUserId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{body}, #{read}, #{readAt}, #{actorUserId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetUrl}, #{imageUrl}, #{metadataJson}::jsonb, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE recipient_user_id = #{recipientUserId} AND read = false

SELECT notification_id, recipient_user_id, type, title, body, read, read_at, actor_user_id, target_type, target_id, target_url, image_url, metadata_json, created_at FROM notifications WHERE notification_id = #{notificationId} AND recipient_user_id = #{recipientUserId} LIMIT 1
